novelty.justification: The novel route is a new latent phenomenon/measurement: the claim predicts that “merely reading a fact silently updates a decodable internal state associated with logically-entailed propositions before any query” and that this read-time signal predicts later ripple success. Searches using “LLM read-time hidden state logical entailment propagation,” “in-context fact update linear probe before query,” “latent world-state belief update transformer,” and “knowledge-edit ripple hidden representations” identified RippleEdits (Cohen et al., 2023), which measures behavioral propagation, Li et al.’s Emergent World Representations (2023), which probes dynamically updated latent world states, and Benchmarking and Understanding Compositional Relational Reasoning of LLMs (2024), which localizes relational-reasoning circuits, but no work establishing this specific pre-query entailment-ripple relationship. The step is a substantive natural extension combining behavioral ripple evaluation with established latent-state probing rather than a new probing paradigm: changing the unit of analysis from queried answers to read-time proposition states is non-trivial and systematic, but broadly predictable from those two literatures.
